content: He soiyi, he fõt edde he zibon

content.text: "Tũwarar dil ferešan no ok, Allare biššaš goro, ar ãre o biššaš goro.
Ãr bafor górot takibar zaga beši ase; ar zodi no takito, ãi tũwarare hoitam; ãi tũwaralla zaga tiyar goitto zair.
Ar ãi zẽtte zaiyum edde tũwaralla zaga tiyar gori, ãi abar aiššum edde tũwarare ãr hãse loi zaiyum, zene ãi zeṛe, tũwara o heṛe oi faro.
Ãi hoṛe zair heṛe zade fõt to tũwara sino."

content: Ṭomase hibare hodde, "Malik, õne hoṛe zorgoi hiyan ãra no zani, ar henot kengori fõt zaniyum?"

content.text: "Ãi oi he fõt, he soiyi edde he zibon, ãr butottu di no gile, honokiye Bafor hãse ai no fare.
Zodi tũwara ãre zanita, toile ãr Bafore o zanita, ar ehon oite tũwara hibare zainno edde hibare deikko."

content: Filipe hodde, "Malik, Bafore ãrare deho, henot hiyan ãralla beši oibo."

content.text: "Filip, ãi eto din tũwarar fũwati asi, ar tarfore o ki ãre no sinili? Hite ze ãre deikke hite Bafore o deikke. Tui tarfore o ken gori hoi faror, 'Bafore ãrare dehao'!
Tui ki biššaš no goros ze ãi Bafor butore asi edde baf ãr butore asede? Ãi tũwarare ze hár hota okkol hoi, hin ãr nizottu no hoi, kintu Baf, ze ãr butore taker, hiba nize ham gore.
Ãre biššaš gor, ze ãi Bafor butore, ar Baf ãr butore ase; ar no oile, ãr hamolla oile o biššaš gor.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, hite ze ãr uwore biššaš ane, ãi ze hár ham okkol gori, hite o he ham okkol goribo, oi, in okkolottuwaro ḍõr ham okkol hite goribo, kiyollahoile ãi Bafor heṛe zairgoi.
Ar tũwara ãr name za kissu saiba, ãi hin goriyum, zene Bafore Futor butore mohimawala gora o.
Ãr name zodi tũwara hono kissu so, ãi hiyan goriyum.
"Tũwara zodi ãre ador goro, toile ãr hokum okkol falon goro.
Ãi ãr Bafottu saiyum, ar hibaye ar ekzon modot goroya defeṛaibo, ze tũwarar fũwati hamiša takibo.
Hiba soiyir Ruh, duniyaiye hibare gosi no fare. Kintu tũwara hibare sino, kiyollahoile hiba tũwarar fũwati take ar tũwarar dilot takibo.
Ãi tũwarare etim raki no zaiyum, ãi tũwarar hãse aiššum.
Hara, duniyaiye ãre ar no dekibo, kintu tũwara dekiba, kiyollahoile ãi zinda asi, tũwara o zinda takiba.
He din tũwara buzi fariba ze, ãi Bafor butore, ar tũwara ãr butore aso, edde ãi tũwarar butore asi.
Hite ze ãr hokum zane edde falon gore, hite ãre ador gore; ar ze ãre ador gore, ãr Bafe o hitare ador goribo. Oi, ãi o hitare ador goriyum, edde nizore hitar hãse forhaš goriyum."

content: Hetunot Ehudaye (Iskariyote no) hibare hodde, "Malik, õne šude ãrar hãse kiyolla forhaš goribade, duniyair hãse kiyolla no?"

content.text: "Hite ze ãre ador gore, hite ãr kalam falon goribo; ar ãr Bafe hitare ador goribo, edde ãra hitar hãse aiššum ar hitar hãse bošoti goijjum.
Hite ze ãre ador no gore, hite ãr kalam falon no gore; ar ze kalam okkol tũwara funor, hin ãr no, kintu Bafor, ze ãre defeṛaiye.
"In okkol ãi tũwarar fũwati takite hoilam.
Kintu he Modotgoroya, Pak Ruh, zare Bafe ãr name defeṛaibo, hibaye tũwarare hár kissu šikka dibo edde ãi tũwarare zin zin hoiyi hin okkol beggun tũwarare monot gori dibo.
Ãi tũwaralla šanti raki zair; ãr šanti ãi tũwarare dir; duniyaiye dede he mozin ãi no di. Tũwarar dilot ferešani no ok, edde ḍor no golok.
"Tũwara ãi hoiyide fuinno, 'Ãi zaiyumboi edde abar tũwarar hãse firi aiššum.' Tũwara zodi ãre ador gorita, toile tũwara kuši oita, ze ãi ãr Bafor hãse zair, kiyollahoile Baf ãttuwaro mohan.
In okkol goṭibar age ãi tũwarare hoi rakilam, toi zene in zẽtte goṭibo tũwara biššaš gori faro.
Ãi tũwara loi ar beši hotun hota no hoiyum; kiyollahoile duniyair šašon goroya aiyer, ãr uwore hitar hono odihar nai,
kintu duniyaiye zene zani fare ze, ãi Bafore ador gori, edde Bafe ãre hokum diyede he mozin ãi gori.
"Aiyo, ãra enttu zaigoi."
